newsitem.title: USA: Exxon eyes Australian mineral asset sale.
newsitem.headline: Exxon eyes Australian mineral asset sale.

text.p: Exxon Corp said on Sunday its affiliate Exxon Coal and Mineral Australia Ltd intended to enter discussions over a possible sale of its Australian coal and mineral assets.
Exxon said while it had not made a decision to sell any asset, it would be evaluating purchase offers.
The company, which was not immediately available for further comment, said the announcement did not refer to any Australian oil, gas, chemical or oil shale assets owned by other Exxon affiliates.

The assets under consideration were Exxon's 100 percent stake in the Lemington Coal Mine, its 100 percent share of Exxon Coal Australia Ltd, its 44 percent share in Mount Thorley Coal Loading Ltd, its 35 percent share in the Golden Grove zinc/copper mine and a minority interest in Newcastle Coal Shippers, the company said.
Exxon Coal Australia had a 36 percent share in Ulan Coal Mines Ltd.
The coal assets were located in New South Wales in southeast Australia and the zinc/copper asset was located in western Australia, the company said.
